SELECT followPosition.*, tutorInfo.tutor_name AS tutorName, userInfo.level_id AS levelId, followRecord.item_type FROM user_follow_up_position followPosition LEFT JOIN tutor_info tutorInfo ON followPosition.tutor_id = tutorInfo.id LEFT JOIN user_info userInfo ON followPosition.user_id = userInfo.id LEFT JOIN user_follow_up_record followRecord ON followPosition.follow_record_id = followRecord.id
followPosition.id = #{param.id} and
followPosition.user_id = #{param.userId} and
followPosition.follow_record_id = #{param.followRecordId} and
followPosition.tutor_id = #{param.tutorId} and
followPosition.position_status = #{param.positionStatus} and
followRecord.item_type = #{param.itemType} and
followPosition.creat_position_time >= #{param.creatPositionTimeStart} and
followPosition.creat_position_time <= #{param.creatPositionTimeEnd} and
(followPosition.stock_code like '%${param.stockCodeOrName}%' or followPosition.stock_name like '%${param.stockCodeOrName}%') and
ORDER BY followPosition.creat_position_time DESC
